base_image_vulns.description: Critical memory corruption vulnerability in zlib compression library with no available fix
base_image_vulns.remediation: No fix currently available. Monitor vendor announcements for updates.

base_image_vulns.description: Expired root certificates in ca-certificates package
base_image_vulns.remediation: Update ca-certificates to version 20240705-r0 or later

base_image_vulns.description: Buffer overflow in musl libc library
base_image_vulns.remediation: Update musl to version 1.2.5-r0 or later
Update busybox to version 1.36.1-r0 or later

base_image_vulns.description: Path traversal in alpine base configuration
base_image_vulns.remediation: Update alpine-baselayout to version 3.4.3-r0 or later

explicit_install_vulns.description: Excessive Resource Consumption Verifying X.509 Policy Constraints in OpenSSL
explicit_install_vulns.remediation: Update openssl to version 3.0.9-r0 or later

explicit_install_vulns.description: IDN wildcard match in curl may lead to certificate validation bypass
explicit_install_vulns.remediation: Update curl to version 8.1.0-r0 or later

explicit_install_vulns.description: Possible DoS translating ASN.1 object identifiers in OpenSSL libssl
explicit_install_vulns.remediation: Update libssl3 to version 3.0.9-r1 or later

explicit_install_vulns.description: Possible DoS translating ASN.1 object identifiers in OpenSSL libcrypto
explicit_install_vulns.remediation: Update libcrypto3 to version 3.0.9-r1 or later

explicit_install_vulns.description: Remote code execution in git client
explicit_install_vulns.remediation: Update git to version 2.43.0-r0 or later

container_vulns.description: Off-by-one error in nginx resolver allows attackers to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code
container_vulns.remediation: Update nginx to version 1.21.1 or later, preferably 1.25.3 for latest security patches

container_vulns.description: Buffer overflow in PostgreSQL allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary code
container_vulns.remediation: Update postgres to version 13.3 or later, preferably 15.5 for latest features and security

container_vulns.description: Integer overflow in Redis STRALGO command allows denial of service
container_vulns.remediation: Update redis to version 6.0.16 or later, preferably 7.2.3 for latest improvements

container_vulns.description: Prototype pollution in Node.js allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code
container_vulns.remediation: Update node to version 16.14.1 or later, preferably LTS version 20.10.0-alpine

container_vulns.description: Unsanitized NUL in environment variables in syscalls in Go allows code execution
container_vulns.remediation: Update golang to version 1.19.3 or later, preferably 1.21.5-alpine for latest features

container_vulns.description: Inherited from base image golang:1.19.0-alpine - Unsanitized NUL in environment variables
container_vulns.remediation: Rebuild with updated golang base image (1.21.5-alpine) and update to v2.4.1

container_vulns.description: Inherited from base image node:16.14.0-alpine - Prototype pollution vulnerability
container_vulns.remediation: Rebuild with updated node base image (20.10.0-alpine) and update to v3.3.2

container_vulns.description: SQL injection vulnerability in MySQL server
container_vulns.remediation: Update mysql to version 8.0.36 or later

container_vulns.description: Memory leak in memcached allows denial of service
container_vulns.remediation: Update memcached to version 1.6.23 or later
